text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki and I bump into Bamboo
Memory
while we're out one day.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Ah, Bamboo. Enjoying a day out?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'm heading to the museum!
Apparently,
they're holding some kind
of special exhibition of
super-rare stuff,
so my mom said I should go!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
What was it again... I think she said they
were
displaying diaries from different
time periods...
Or maybe it was essays?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Oh... Perhaps the exhibition includes
writings
from legendary martial artists.
I'm quite intrigued!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After hearing this, we decide to
accompany
Bamboo Memory to the
museum.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Man, that exhibit was pretty impressive!
All that
handwriting was so squiggly
though. I couldn't
really read what
anything said.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I keep thinking about one of the diaries I
saw.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeaaah, you mean that one you were
checking
out super close? What was it
the plaque said
again?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Martial arts have become meaningless."
The
author recorded their feeling for
years and
concluded that endless years
of battle have
resulted in a nothingness.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I am familiar with these notions. I am also
familiar
with someone else who feels this
way.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
She's an Umamusume who trained above
me in
the martial arts. She was among
the very finest—a
martial arts virtuoso
who attained complete
mastery at a
young age.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
She was mighty and kind, but what really
stood
out was her determination to
master the martial
arts. Many deeply
admired her, myself included.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
But things began to change when she
entered the
Warriors of Heaven and
Earth Tournament.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Classmate
text_block_list.text:
I gave that final match all I had to offer.
I utilized
all the Yaegaki techniques I'd
acquired against an
opponent who had
bested the finest warriors.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Classmate
text_block_list.text:
It was a thrill like no other to face off
against the
strongest opponent while at
the peak of my
abilities, and in a
climactic match, at that.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Classmate
text_block_list.text:
It shouldn't come as a surprise, then,
that I've felt
empty since then. It's like
my life no longer has
a... destination.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
After that, she abandoned the Kongo
Yaegaki
style. Even now, I have no idea
of her
whereabouts.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
The path of self-refinement ought to
stretch out
indefinitely. And yet, if I
were to glimpse its end
the way she
did...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I wonder what I would do.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Yaeno, can I borrow you for a
sec?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I've changed clothes as you've
instructed, but...
what are we doing
exactly?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Isn't it obvious?! We're going for a run!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Just see if you can overtake me! This is a

no-holds-barred, full-throttle contest!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Bamboo?! Ngh, wait!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
What's wrong? Is that all you got?! Don't
blame
me if you take it easy and get
whooped!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Ngh! What was that?! Watch and witness
the
power of the Yaegaki style!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno & Bamboo
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff... It seems you've grown even stronger!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Do you get it now?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Even if you feel like you've reached the
end of
the path, your friendly foes will
always be there
to overtake you again!
We're not gonna give you
any time to
feel empty inside!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: So you've gotta grow eeeven stronger, just like we're gonna get even stronger too!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Basically, everything's gonna be totally
fine!
There's nothing to worry about!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Bamboo...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I'm truly blessed to be surrounded
by such
people.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I'm truly blessed to be surrounded
by such
people.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Friendly foes... Indeed. What a terrific
way of
putting it.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I have to wonder now—what might have

happened if my fellow pupil had known
this
feeling?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki gazes up at the sky, as if
a weight's
been lifted from her
shoulders. And yet, her
expression is not
without a subtle sadness.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Indeed... If only I could become her
"friendly foe."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: No, I will become that challenge for her! Not only in terms of strength, but also by attaining a state of mind that allows me to empathize with her struggles!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
And in preparation for that day... I shall
continue
to devote myself to progress!
